style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, no drawn overlays
motion_rule: HE is the subject of every window and crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY window, talking ones too, always SIDEWAYS, NEVER toward or away from the lens; he never hovers, drifts or talks sitting still: every move starts by shoving off glass, gravel or furniture; the camera stays inside the tank at the glass and HE fills half the frame height in every window, never a wide shot of the tank or the room; legs in shot, nothing between him and the lens, never facing the lens while talking; a new tight shot size every window; the last frame still moves
character: a glossy red lobster in a black tailcoat, a monocle, ONE huge claw and one small
props: a blank cream price tag on a string on his small claw; a red velvet rope; a velvet stool
prop_continuity: the tag stays on him to the last frame; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: inside a glass tank on a marble table in a rich salon, gilt frames and chandeliers blurred beyond the glass; gravel floor with a slope, a velvet stool in the tank; HE stays in the tank
lighting: bright chandelier light through the water

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim, nothing added or repeated; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, calm and unhurried, even 4.3 syllables per second
audio.pacing: speech 0.7-2.3 and 2.9-7.8; voiceless outside, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable
audio.sfx: muffled clinking beyond the glass, water surging, gravel scattering, claws on glass, a rope whipping

timeline.a: silent. THE LOBSTER shoves off the glass at top speed and rakes the tank left to right past the lens, gravel bursting, A CRAB spun aside
THE LOBSTER slams the far glass, kicks off it and tears back right to left along the bottom
THE LOBSTER cartwheels claw over tail edge to edge across the gravel, THE CRAB ducking under him
THE LOBSTER hits the stool, springs off the seat and slings himself along the gravel
THE LOBSTER throws himself on his back and skids the full width of the tank on his shell, legs pedalling
still on his shell THE LOBSTER whips his tail and shoots back the other way under the stool
THE LOBSTER flips upright, rams the slope and climbs it the whole frame height
THE LOBSTER launches off the slope and sails edge to edge over both CRABS
THE LOBSTER punches the gravel and rebounds bottom of frame to top
THE LOBSTER tears along the glass right at the lens, the tag snapping behind him
THE LOBSTER kicks the glass and drives edge to edge, then kicks the far wall and drives straight back
THE LOBSTER rams the stool and shoves it across the tank, A CRAB scrambling off it
THE LOBSTER hurls himself up the glass bottom of frame to top, gravel raining off him
THE LOBSTER drops astride the stool and throws the big claw up in a museum pose, THE CRABS whipping the rope across the tank, it still swinging

must_appear: the tag on him throughout, gravel flying, both crabs, tailcoat and monocle, the rope at 10.0
negative_prompt: speech bubble, comic balloon, cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, blood, gore, night, dark scene, a still camera, a wide shot, a small hero, a hovering hero, a hero talking while still, macro on a small prop, human hands in the tank, a frozen final frame, slow motion, any word after 7.8, silence in the tail
